notes.title: Gravewatch Release Date!
notes.notes:
Gravewatch will release on September 30th, 2025!

A brand new trailer is here, and with it, a new version of the demo! This updated demo is a massive step up from previous versions and includes:
- Real voice acting
- Brand new or reworked locations
- New mechanics and collectibles
- Huge improvements to the UI and the main menu
- New animations and polish of the main characters
- Better graphics and performance

... and much, MUCH more!

For the past few months, you’ve been hearing a lot about the development of Gravewatch, and now, I would like to hear from you... The game has been moved to a standalone demo page, meaning that from now on, you can leave a public review of the demo!

Whether you like the new version or not, I would be glad if you could take a couple of minutes and be one of the first to review this game, as every piece of feedback is highly appreciated! ♡

Trailer YouTube link →  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wi6rjfC-SA0

Stay tuned for more news about Gravewatch!

notes.title: Massive Demo update
notes.notes:
As I am slowly working on the full game, I have gathered a lot of valuable feedback from the demo. I have used this feedback to, not only improve the full game but also the demo, and now that the "Czech & Slovak" game week is around the corner, I figured it would be a great time to upload a new, fresh version of the demo. Major parts of the demo have been reworked to closer resemble what you can expect from a full game.

- Major parts of the demo have been completely reworked
- Added difficulty settings
- Better performance, especially on low-end PCs
- MANY quality of life changes
- MANY bug fixes
and so much more...

This should be one of the last major updates for the demo, so I would like to thank everyone for your feedback and hope to see you in the full game!

notes.title: Biggest demo hotfix yet
notes.notes:
Just deployed biggest demo hotfix yet! This should fix vast majority of remaining problems in the demo.

- Reworked interaction system
- Fixed a bug that could prevent a player from finishing the car scene
- Encounter with Casper and his dog should now be a little bit easier
- Readjusted the location/number of valuables that have to be collected around the graveyard
- Mouse sensitivity can now be correctly adjusted
- Small terrain fixes
- Flashlight now looks much better and more realistic
- A couple of minor bug fixes

notes.title: Quick hotfix
notes.notes:
It's been just 24 hours since the demo's release and so far, I'm surprised that everything is working as intended with no reported crashes or game-breaking bugs. However, there have been a couple of small issues that should be resolved with today's hotfix:

- Fixed an issue where opening a menu while interacting with an object could bug out the text on the screen
- Multiple fixes to how the player character interacts with readable objects in the world
- Fixed a couple of spelling mistakes in both languages (Czech and English)
